headline: Grant requests for a $3.5M Fire Station 2 project and a $250,000 planning grant, plus a Newhall Foundation repair bid waiver.
summary: Eight standing committees also meet, taking up items such as a $70,000 special education request, an opioid case manager agreement, and a police contract with Catalis. Two tax appeal settlements and a plant donation for DeNicola Park are on the agenda too.
items: Hamden Through Time invitation from CPKK, with flyers and a request that the council join
Public and town correspondence, including a request to confirm Rhonda Caldwell for the Newhall Foundation Oversight Advisory Committee
Fleet proposal from Town Administration, not yet referred to a committee
Tree Commission request for regular meetings between council committees and boards and commissions
Request to make the High School roof bid available to the School Building Committee
Order to accept a facility dog from Puppies Behind Bars for the Hamden Police Department
Administration & Settlement: two tax appeal resolutions and ten administration requests, including a Newhall Foundation bid waiver and a plant donation for DeNicola Park
IT & Civic Engagement: reappointments of Mike Doyle and Reginald Jackson to the Veterans Commission, and a Vertosoft OpenGov software agreement
Public Safety: Police Department agreement with Hamden Public Schools, and a Catalis police contract
Finance: $70,000 special education funding request and $11,787 Public Works budget transfer
Finance: opioid case manager agreement with Yale University
Finance: easement at 3360 Whitney Avenue and sanitary easement at 151 Arch St, 45 Churchill St, and 90 Santa Fe
location: Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518
